current.text: He re-signed with the Spurs on a one-year deal worth 8 million USD.
Tobias Harris has taken his starting forward spot. Barnes is not in the projected starting five or in the main bench group.
The Spurs are very deep at forward, and team minutes may stay low after the long playoff run.
He projects as a locker room presence and break-glass depth piece who will be out of the rotation on many nights.
Experts call him a 1 USD player even in 14-team leagues, so he is not a draft target in our 12-team league.

durable.text: He is a low-usage player who mostly stands in the corner and hits threes.
He is reliable and rarely misses games.

note: Barnes ranks 263 on Yahoo and 256 on ESPN, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he was not drafted in our league last season. That leaves him far outside the 144 players we draft, so do not draft him. His projections drop to about 8 points and 1.3 threes in roughly 20 minutes, and no category stands out enough to make him a build fit. Leave him on waivers, and only look at him if injuries to the Spurs forwards push him back into real minutes.
